methodology: Supabase list_edge_functions/get_edge_function: inspected all five deployed source entrypoints and configuration; cross-checked local backend auth guards; did NOT probe endpoints or modify remote data

sourceChecks: GET /api/v20/health public nonfinancial state
Origin allowlist and method/routing restrictions
Financial cloud gate denies state/prepare/commit while policy checks false
When enabled, Bearer format, Supabase auth/v1/user and session_id verification, confirmed owner checks and DB-scoped assertSession
edgeFunctions.securityConclusion: Source supports fail-closed on all financial routes with currently closed policy; no live pen-test executed

sourceChecks: Entire handler returns HTTP 503 and code QA_COMPLETE_CLOSED
Cache-Control no-store
edgeFunctions.securityConclusion: No business endpoints remain implemented in deployed 111-character entrypoint

sourceChecks: Expiry hardcoded 2026-10-25T09:57:44.973Z, expired at snapshot
Before privileged routes: constant-time SHA-256 capability validation and fixed QA run scope
Account IDs/project IDs restricted to fixed two test users
Bootstrap and finish routes accept only capability, not standard Bearer; expiration blocks bootstrap
Other test routes require scoped JWT, app-level auth/v1/user verification, strict limited route whitelist
QA code constructs a temporary permissive policy for isolated fixtures, not authorized for production
edgeFunctions.securityConclusion: Expired ephemeral QA interface; must not reuse its test-only policy or secrets in real account service

sourceChecks: Entire handler returns HTTP 503 and code PRIVATE_PROVISION_CLOSED
Cache-Control no-store
edgeFunctions.securityConclusion: No user provisioning remains in deployed 115-character handler

sourceChecks: Server-side allowlist of test owner(s), no general public role access
Session is verified by Supabase auth/v1/user and auth.sessions via app-level auth guard
In every transaction, verified test scope and raw_app_meta_data marker must match operator scope
Test derived HMAC key uses backend secret and fixed domain separation; no secret shared to frontend
Restrictive Origin and method validation; health is nonfinancial
Response marks X-BTCSP-Production-Approved:false
edgeFunctions.securityConclusion: Meaningful application-level access checks; do not assume safe against all unauthenticated and cross-tenant requests until controlled dynamic tests

crossCuttingFindings.detail: 5/5 deployed functions have verify_jwt=false; app-level Bearer/CORS/owner guards on active routes do not replace end-to-end adversarial checks
Private test API is active on main Supabase project and may rely on privileged server key; isolate/decommission only after owner-approved safe transition; avoid blind deletion
Expired QA function creates its own temporary enabled gates for isolated test fixture, distinct from production policy; never copy to prod
No authenticated two-account cross-owner requests, invalid-token probes, compromised password tests, CSRF/CORS live browser probes or restore tests performed
